clips.title: The story
paras: Magatha Grimtotem sends a warning from Thunder Bluff: Arikara may be hunting High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. She sends Horde adventurers to summon and slay the ancient wind serpent on the burial spires of Thousand Needles.

Magatha Grimtotem enchants the refined Incendia powder, a reagent, to call Arikara. She warns that ancient tauren traditions have changed too quickly under the new Horde alliance, stirring the vengeance of the ferocious wind serpent spirit. Magatha sends you south to the canyon of Thousand Needles. She tells you to cast the powder onto a ritual pyre among the elevated burial sites of Darkcloud Pinnacle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this refined and purified Incendia Powder to Thousand Needles and toss it on the sacred fire of life. It is located in the Darkcloud Pinnacle on an isolated needle where they bury their dead.
The enchantment that I have weaved into the Incendia powder will summon Arikara to you, friend.
I fear she may be stalking Cairne Bloodhoof; too much Tauren lore has changed, and I fear this has angered Arikara. Move quickly before all is lost, adventurer!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you slain the vicious serpent Arikara, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This does not make sense. Why would Arikara be after Cairne Bloodhoof? Magatha could not be wrong, she is our most powerful shaman.
Regardless, your great deed to the Horde shall not go unnoticed - please, choose one of these as a reward for your aid.
